name: TaskFlow
description: A responsive daily task manager built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

paragraphs: TaskFlow is a modern, responsive, and highly interactive To-Do list web application designed to help users manage their daily tasks efficiently. Built with a state-driven architecture, it ensures a seamless user experience with a clean UI, essential accessibility features, and professional development best practices.
features: Task Management: Easily add, delete, and mark tasks as completed.
Dynamic Dashboard: Real-time statistics showing Total, Active, Completed tasks, and a progress percentage.
Advanced Filtering & Search: Filter tasks by 'All', 'Active', or 'Completed' status, and search through tasks in real-time.
Local Storage Persistence: Your tasks are saved directly in your browser's local storage.
Smart Empty States: Professional empty state messages when no tasks exist or when search/filters return no results.

whatItDoes.text: TaskFlow is a modern, responsive, and highly interactive To-Do list web application designed to help users manage their daily tasks efficiently. Built with a state-driven architecture, it ensures a seamless user experience with a clean UI, essential accessibility features, and professional development best practices.

requirements.text: Many task management tools are overly complex, slow, or require accounts just to keep track of simple daily activities.
